systems.system: outil de gestion digitalisée (school management tool tracking teacher presence and mobility and pupil attendance)
systems.owner: CPS du secteur Education, with support from the Projet d'Appui à la Décentralisation de l'Éducation au Mali (PADEM)
systems.tiers: Moved to operational scale 8-12 December 2025; training to be deployed in the académies d'enseignement for the Conseillers à l'Orientation of the Centres d'Animation Pédagogique, IT staff and heads of planning divisions; data collection tools meant to secure reporting up from the collectivités territoriales

note: Statistical bulletin: collectivités territoriales appear as a source of education data reported upward and as participants in regional planning sessions. The one system named is used in the education ministry's field structures; nothing states that any local government office is connected.
